name: Standing toe touch
summary: A gentle, rhythmic forward fold that wakes up the backs of the legs and the spine.
steps: Stand tall, feet hip-width apart, knees soft.
Hinge at the hips and let your spine round slowly as you reach toward your toes.
Go only as far as is comfortable, then roll back up one vertebra at a time.
cues: Breathe out on the way down
Keep a small bend in the knees

name: Leg swings
summary: Dynamic hip mobility: swing one leg forward and back, then side to side, holding a wall for balance.
steps: Stand side-on to a wall with one hand on it for balance.
Swing the outside leg forward and back in a smooth arc, growing the range gradually.
Face the wall and swing the same leg across your body and out to the side.
Repeat on the other leg.
cues: Tall torso — the leg moves, not the back
mistakes: Leaning or twisting the torso to swing higher

name: Cat–cow
summary: Alternately round and arch the spine on hands and knees to mobilise the whole back.
steps: Start on hands and knees: hands under shoulders, knees under hips.
Breathe out, tuck the tailbone and round your back toward the ceiling, chin toward chest (cat).
Breathe in, let the belly drop and lift the chest and tailbone (cow).
Flow slowly between the two.
cues: Push the floor away in the cat
Match the movement to your breath

name: Child's pose ↔ cobra
summary: Flow from sitting back on the heels (spine flexed, lats stretched) forward into a low cobra (spine extended).
steps: From hands and knees, sit your hips back toward your heels with arms long in front — child's pose.
Shift forward, lowering your hips toward the floor between your hands.
Press gently through the hands to lift the chest into a low cobra, shoulders down and back.
Push back into child's pose. Repeat four or five times.
cues: Shoulders away from the ears in cobra
Only lift as high as the low back is comfortable
mistakes: Forcing the cobra with straight, locked arms

name: Seated spinal twist
summary: A controlled rotation through the upper back while seated tall.
steps: Sit tall on the floor or a bench.
Grow tall through the crown of your head, then rotate the ribcage to one side.
Use your hands lightly to hold the end range, breathing into it.
Return to centre and repeat on the other side.
cues: Rotate from the ribs, not by yanking with the arms

name: Lying spinal twist
summary: Lying on your back, cross one leg over the body toward the floor while the shoulders stay down.
steps: Lie on your back, arms out wide.
Bend one knee and let it fall across your body toward the floor on the other side.
Keep both shoulders heavy on the floor; turn your head the opposite way if comfortable.
Return and switch sides.
mistakes: Forcing the knee to the floor

name: Wide-stance cross-over toe touch
summary: Feet wide, hinge and rotate to reach one hand toward the opposite foot, alternating sides.
steps: Stand with feet wide and arms out to the sides.
Hinge at the hips and rotate to bring one hand toward the opposite foot; the other arm reaches up.
Return to standing and alternate sides.
cues: Hinge at the hips first, then rotate
mistakes: Rounding hard through the low back to reach further

name: Kneeling hip flexor stretch
summary: Half-kneeling stretch for the front of the hip, which tightens with long sitting.
steps: Kneel on one knee (pad it), other foot flat in front.
Squeeze the glute of the kneeling side and tuck the pelvis slightly.
Shift forward until you feel a stretch at the front of the hip. Hold, then switch.
mistakes: Arching the low back instead of opening the hip

name: Hamstring stretch
summary: A held stretch for the back of the thigh, done lying or with the heel on a low support.
steps: Lie on your back, or place a heel on a low step with the leg nearly straight.
Keep your back flat and hinge (or raise the leg) until you feel a stretch behind the thigh.
Hold 20–30 seconds, breathing slowly, then switch legs.
cues: Flat back, hinge at the hip
mistakes: Rounding the back to reach further

name: Arm circles
summary: Small-to-large circles with straight arms to warm the shoulders.
steps: Stand tall with arms out to the sides at shoulder height.
Make small circles forward, gradually growing them.
Reverse direction.

name: Standing hip circles
summary: Hands on hips, draw large circles with the pelvis to mobilise the hips.
steps: Stand with hands on hips, feet shoulder-width apart.
Circle the hips slowly one way, then the other.
cues: Make the circle as big as is comfortable

name: Bodyweight squat
summary: The basic squat pattern: sit down and back between your heels, then stand up.
steps: Stand with feet about shoulder-width apart, toes turned out slightly.
Brace your trunk, then bend knees and hips together to sit down between your heels.
Go as low as you can keep your heels down and back neutral.
Drive through the whole foot to stand up tall.
mistakes: Rounding the low back at the bottom

name: Dumbbell goblet squat
summary: A squat holding one dumbbell vertically against your chest. The front load keeps you upright and teaches good depth.
steps: Hold one dumbbell vertically by the top end, cupped against your chest, elbows pointing down.
Stand with feet slightly wider than hips, toes turned out a little.
Brace, then sit down between your heels, keeping the chest up and the dumbbell close.
At the bottom, elbows sit just inside the knees. Drive up through the whole foot.
cues: Elbows inside the knees at the bottom
mistakes: Letting the dumbbell drift away from the body

name: Dumbbell squat
summary: A squat holding a dumbbell in each hand at your sides.
steps: Stand tall with a dumbbell at each side, palms facing in.
Sit down between your heels, keeping the chest up and arms hanging straight.
Drive back up through the whole foot.

name: Dumbbell step-up
summary: Step onto a stable box or bench with a dumbbell in each hand. Finish all reps on one leg before switching.
steps: Use a sturdy, non-slip box or bench about knee height or lower.
Place the whole lead foot on the box.
Press through the lead heel to stand up on the box; bring the trailing foot up.
Step back down with the trailing leg under control. Keep the same lead leg for the set, then switch.
cues: Drive through the lead heel — don't push off the back foot
mistakes: Pushing off the floor with the trailing leg

name: Dumbbell lunge
summary: Step forward into a split stance, lower until both knees are bent about 90°, and push back.
steps: Stand tall with a dumbbell at each side.
Take a long step forward and lower the back knee toward the floor.
Push through the front heel to return to standing.
cues: Front knee over the middle of the foot
Back knee hovers just above the floor
mistakes: Short steps that drive the knee far past the toes

name: Dumbbell reverse lunge
summary: A lunge stepping backward — easier on the knees and balance than the forward version.
steps: Stand tall with a dumbbell at each side.
Step one foot back and lower the back knee toward the floor.
Drive through the front heel to return.
cues: Most of the weight in the front leg

name: Dumbbell split squat
summary: A lunge without stepping: feet stay fixed in a split stance as you lower and rise.
steps: Take a long split stance with a dumbbell in each hand.
Lower straight down until the back knee nearly touches the floor.
Press up through the front foot. Finish the set, then switch legs.
cues: Straight down and up, like an elevator

name: Dumbbell Romanian deadlift
summary: The hip-hinge: push the hips back with soft knees, sliding the dumbbells down the legs, then stand by driving the hips forward.
steps: Stand tall with a dumbbell in each hand in front of your thighs, knees slightly bent.
Push your hips back as if closing a car door with your bum. Let the dumbbells slide down close to your legs.
Keep your back flat and neck long; stop when you feel a strong hamstring stretch, usually around mid-shin.
Squeeze the glutes and drive the hips forward to stand up tall.
mistakes: Squatting the weight down instead of hinging
Rounding the back to reach lower

name: Standing dumbbell calf raise
summary: Rise onto the balls of your feet and lower slowly, holding dumbbells at your sides.
steps: Stand tall, dumbbells at your sides (balls of the feet on a step for more range).
Rise as high as you can onto your toes, pause.
Lower slowly, all the way down.

name: Glute bridge
summary: Lying on your back, drive the hips up by squeezing the glutes.
steps: Lie on your back, knees bent, feet flat and hip-width apart.
Press through the heels and squeeze the glutes to lift the hips until knees, hips and shoulders line up.
Pause, then lower with control.
cues: Squeeze the glutes at the top
Ribs down — don't arch the low back

name: Incline dumbbell chest press
summary: A press on a bench set to roughly 30–45° that emphasises the upper chest.
steps: Set the bench to about 30–45°. Sit back with a dumbbell on each thigh.
Kick the dumbbells up one at a time as you lie back; feet flat, shoulder blades pulled back and down.
Start with the dumbbells over your upper chest, palms forward or slightly turned in.
Lower under control until elbows are just below the bench line, forearms vertical. Press up and slightly together.
cues: Shoulder blades pinned back and down
Elbows about 45° from the body, not flared to 90°
mistakes: Bench too steep (turns it into a shoulder press)
Lifting the hips off the bench

name: Flat dumbbell bench press
summary: A press lying flat on a bench, the foundation chest exercise.
steps: Lie on a flat bench with feet flat, shoulder blades squeezed together.
Start with dumbbells above the chest, arms straight.
Lower to the sides of the chest with elbows about 45° from the body.
Press back up.

name: Push-up
summary: Lower your body as a rigid plank and press back up.
steps: Hands slightly wider than shoulders, body in a straight line from head to heels.
Lower the chest toward the floor, elbows about 45° from the body.
Press back up, keeping the plank.
cues: Squeeze glutes and brace the core

name: Incline push-up
summary: A push-up with hands on a bench or wall — easier, and great for building up to floor push-ups.
steps: Hands on a sturdy bench, body in a straight line.
Lower the chest to the edge.
Press back up.

name: Dumbbell chest fly
summary: Open the arms in a wide arc with a fixed slight elbow bend, then hug them back together.
steps: Lie on a bench with dumbbells above your chest, palms facing each other, elbows slightly bent.
Open the arms in a wide arc until you feel a chest stretch.
Bring them back together along the same arc.
mistakes: Going too deep with heavy weight

name: Standing dumbbell shoulder press
summary: Press dumbbells from the shoulders to overhead while standing — the core has to keep you from arching.
steps: Stand with feet hip-width, dumbbells at shoulder height, palms forward or slightly in.
Brace your abs and squeeze your glutes so the ribs stay down.
Press straight up until the arms are long overhead, dumbbells over the shoulders.
Lower under control back to shoulder height.
cues: Ribs down, glutes tight — no back arch
mistakes: Leaning back to finish the rep
Using leg drive without meaning to

name: Seated dumbbell shoulder press
summary: The shoulder press seated on an upright bench, for more stability.
steps: Sit on a bench set upright, back supported.
Start with dumbbells at shoulder height.
Press overhead, then lower with control.

name: Arnold press
summary: A shoulder press that starts palms-in in front of the face and rotates to palms-forward overhead.
steps: Start with dumbbells in front of your shoulders, palms facing you.
Press up while rotating the palms to face forward.
Reverse the rotation on the way down.

name: Dumbbell lateral raise
summary: Raise light dumbbells out to the sides to shoulder height, targeting the middle part of the shoulder.
steps: Stand tall with light dumbbells at your sides, a slight bend in the elbows.
Raise the arms out to the sides, leading with the elbows, until they reach shoulder height.
Pause briefly, then lower slowly.
mistakes: Shrugging the weight up with the traps

name: Dumbbell front raise
summary: Raise dumbbells in front of you to shoulder height.
steps: Stand with dumbbells in front of the thighs, palms facing you.
Raise them forward to shoulder height with a slight elbow bend.
Lower slowly.

name: Overhead dumbbell triceps extension
summary: Hold one dumbbell overhead with both hands and bend only at the elbows.
steps: Hold one dumbbell overhead with both hands under the top end.
Lower it behind your head by bending the elbows.
Extend back to straight arms.
cues: Elbows point forward and stay close

name: Dumbbell triceps kickback
summary: Hinged forward with the upper arm fixed by your side, straighten the elbow behind you.
steps: Hinge forward with a flat back, upper arm parallel to the floor.
Straighten the elbow to bring the dumbbell back.
Lower under control without moving the upper arm.

name: Bench-supported single-arm dumbbell row
summary: One hand (and usually the same-side knee) on a bench, row a dumbbell toward your hip with a flat, still back. The photos show the staggered-stance version; the knee-on-bench setup is the same pull.
steps: Place one knee and the same-side hand on a flat bench; the other foot is on the floor, out to the side for a stable base.
Make your back flat and roughly parallel to the floor, neck in line, shoulders square to the floor.
Let the dumbbell hang straight down from the shoulder.
Pull the elbow up and back toward your hip, squeezing the shoulder blade toward the spine. Lower with control. Finish the set, then switch sides.
cues: Pull the elbow to the hip, not the hand to the chest
mistakes: Yanking with the arm or shrugging
Supporting leg too close for balance

name: Bent-over dumbbell row
summary: Hinge forward and row both dumbbells toward your hips.
steps: Hinge to about 45° with a flat back, dumbbells hanging.
Row both elbows back toward your hips.
Lower with control while holding the hinge.

name: Bent-over reverse fly
summary: Hinged forward, open the arms out to the sides to work the back of the shoulders.
steps: Hinge forward with a flat back, light dumbbells hanging, elbows slightly bent.
Raise the arms out to the sides until level with the body.
Lower slowly.

name: Dumbbell pullover
summary: Lying on a bench, lower one dumbbell in an arc behind your head and pull it back over the chest.
steps: Lie on a bench holding one dumbbell over your chest with both hands.
With a slight elbow bend, lower it in an arc behind your head.
Pull it back over your chest.
mistakes: Arching the back at the bottom
Bending the elbows more to cheat

name: Dumbbell shrug
summary: Lift the shoulders straight up toward the ears, pause, and lower.
steps: Stand with a dumbbell at each side.
Lift the shoulders straight up, pause.
Lower slowly.
cues: Straight up and down — no rolling

name: Dumbbell biceps curl
summary: Curl the dumbbells up with the elbows fixed at your sides, turning the palms up as you lift.
steps: Stand tall, dumbbells at your sides, palms facing in.
Keeping the elbows pinned to your sides, curl the weights up.
As you lift, turn the wrists so the palms face up (and slightly out) at the top.
Squeeze, then lower slowly to full extension.
cues: Turn the wrist as you curl
mistakes: Cutting the bottom of the rep short

name: Hammer curl
summary: A curl with palms facing each other throughout, which also works the forearm.
steps: Stand with dumbbells at your sides, palms facing in.
Curl up keeping the palms facing in.
Lower slowly.

name: Abdominal crunch
summary: Curl the ribcage toward the pelvis, lifting just the shoulder blades from the floor.
steps: Lie on your back, knees bent, feet flat. Hands lightly behind your head or crossed on the chest.
Breathe out and curl your ribs toward your hips, lifting the shoulder blades off the floor.
Pause, then lower slowly.
cues: Look at the ceiling — fist-sized gap under the chin

name: Reverse crunch
summary: Curl the pelvis up toward the ribs, bringing the knees toward the chest.
steps: Lie on your back, knees bent at 90° above the hips.
Curl the hips off the floor toward the ribs.
Lower slowly.
cues: Low back gently into the floor

name: Plank
summary: Hold a straight line from head to heels on forearms and toes.
steps: Forearms under shoulders, legs straight behind you.
Squeeze glutes and brace the core to form a straight line.
Hold, breathing steadily.

name: Side plank
summary: Support yourself on one forearm and the side of your feet, body in a straight line.
steps: Lie on your side, elbow under shoulder.
Lift the hips so the body forms a straight line.
Hold, then switch sides. Bend the knees to make it easier.

name: Dead bug
summary: On your back, slowly extend opposite arm and leg while keeping the low back flat.
steps: Lie on your back, arms up, knees bent at 90° over the hips.
Lower the opposite arm and leg toward the floor while the low back stays down.
Return and alternate.
cues: Low back glued to the floor

name: Russian twist
summary: Seated and leaning back, rotate the torso side to side.
steps: Sit with knees bent, lean back to about 45° with a long spine.
Rotate the ribcage to one side, then the other.
Keep the feet down to make it easier.

name: Mountain climbers
summary: From a high plank, drive the knees toward the chest alternately.
steps: Start in a high plank, hands under shoulders.
Drive one knee toward the chest, then switch quickly.
Keep the hips level.

name: Superman
summary: Lying face down, lift the arms, chest and legs a little off the floor.
steps: Lie face down, arms overhead.
Lift arms, chest and legs slightly, squeezing the glutes.
Pause and lower.
